results.title: 5 Best ShipStation Alternatives for Small Business (2026) | Ship.com | Shipping Made Simple
results.content:
The best ShipStation alternative for most small businesses in 2026 is Ship.com, which starts at $4.99/month and offers up to 89% off USPS and up to 82% off UPS retail rates. Shippo is the strongest pick if you need 40+ carriers, Pirate Ship if you want completely free software, Easyship if you ship internationally at volume, and Stamps.com if you send as much mail as you do packages. All five cost less to start than ShipStation's $14.99/month entry plan.

## Why small businesses leave ShipStation [...] ### What is the cheapest ShipStation alternative?

Pirate Ship is the cheapest at $0/month, though it only supports USPS and UPS. Among full-featured paid platforms, Ship.com is the least expensive at $4.99/month, versus $14.99/month for ShipStation's lowest plan.

### Does ShipStation have a free plan?

ShipStation offers a limited free tier for basic label printing and a 30-day free trial of its paid plans. Its paid plans start at $14.99/month for 50 shipments, and the price rises with your monthly volume.

### Which ShipStation alternative has the best shipping rates? [...] The trade-off is scope. Pirate Ship supports exactly two carriers — USPS and UPS — and support is live chat and email only. There's no email marketing, loyalty program, or phone line. If free is the priority and your needs are simple, it's excellent; if you outgrow it, see our list of Pirate Ship alternatives.

## 4. Easyship — best for international shipping

Easyship offers a free plan for low volumes, with paid plans starting at $29/month (Plus) and $69/month (Premier). Its standout features are international: duty and tax calculation at checkout, courier comparison across a large global network, and prepaid returns.

results.title: The Best ShipStation Alternatives for Ecommerce Brands That Have Outgrown the Basics | VESYL
results.content:
The best ShipStation alternative depends on which limitations you are hitting and what your operation looks like at the next stage of growth.

If the primary issue is monthly fee and pricing structure, focus your evaluation on platforms with transparent fixed pricing, no per-label fees, and cost efficiency that improves as volume scales.

If the primary issue is API restrictions, prioritize platforms where API access is included across plans rather than locked to pro plans or higher tiers.

If the primary issue is customer support, ask for specifics during any demo. Request response time commitments. Talk to existing customers if you can. [...] The best alternatives depend on your specific needs. For high-volume brands needing multi carrier shipping, transparent pricing, and real customer support, VESYL is the most purpose-built option. Shippo suits brands wanting API access on a free tier. Pirate Ship is a strong free shipping software option for small businesses focused on USPS and UPS domestically. Easyship leads on international shipping, and Veeqo is a strong free alternative for Amazon sellers.
